'''Pauls Stradiņš Jr.''' (born 1963) is a physicist at the [[National Renewable Energy Laboratory]] in [[Golden, Colorado]], and a foreign member of the [[Latvian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>[https://www.nrel.gov/research/pauls-stradins.html NREL profile for Paul Stradins, NREL Principal Scientist]</ref><ref>[http://www.nrel.gov/news/press/2016/21617 NREL Theorizes Defects Could Improve Solar Cells: January 12, 2016]</ref><ref>[http://inside.mines.edu/PH-pauls-stradins Paul Stradins profile page for Department of Physics at Colorado School of Mines]</ref>

Currently he is the principal scientist and a project leader of the silicon photovoltaics group at NREL.<ref>Stradins, P., and Kondo, M., Staebler-Wronski Effect: Physics and Relevance to Devices, pp. 220-243 '''<u>In</u>''' Kolobov, A. V. Photo-Induced Metastability in Amorphous Semiconductors.  Page xxiv shows mailing address of Stradins in List of Contributors</ref>  He leads a team that recently theorized that defects in photovoltaic cells could actually improve the performance of those cells.<ref>[http://www.nrel.gov/news/press/2016/21617 NREL Theorizes Defects Could Improve Solar Cells: January 12, 2016]</ref>

He is the grandson of [[Pauls Stradiņš]] (17 January 1896 – 14 August 1958), a [[Latvia]]n professor and physician.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.stradini.lv/page/6 |title=Pauls Stradiņš |publisher=[[Pauls Stradiņš Clinical University Hospital]] |accessdate=2009-12-19 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20090526235430/http://www.stradini.lv/page/6 |archivedate=2009-05-26 }}</ref>
